name: Sprint 6: production-grade experience
goal: Sponsor feedback: the UI must look and feel like a production application, with a demo persona switcher. Design system and shell, persona switcher, four app redesigns reviewed on screenshots, redeploy.
carryOver: S5-QE-03 intermittent CSR UI test (folded into the CSR redesign ticket)

went_well: Production-grade redesign of all four apps, demo persona bar, one live program dashboard
Demo audit tool (scripts/demo-audit.mjs) found 33 real demo defects; 12 personas now load clean
didnt: Bug-bash fix rounds were expensive ($57 for five tickets); two review rounds per ticket plus the full suite per review
Agents hit the weekly usage limit mid-workflow; the orchestrator finished round 2 directly
carryOver: RA-07..14 minor demo defects (raw coverage codes in triage text, claimant chat skips holder check, counter off by one, KPI label, document-read audit rows, repeated names, placeholder narrative, stale CSR status)
Claimant Spanish confirmation UI test is load-sensitive under the full suite (passes alone)
retro.change: Sponsor directive 2026-10-19: wrap-up within $75; review and QA only where a defect would show in the demo. One review per ticket, the orchestrator runs the full suite once per wave.
